description: Migrate a 500M-vector embedding index from Pinecone to a self-hosted Qdrant cluster. Must: provision Qdrant cluster (3 nodes, replicated), rebuild the index from source data (text embeddings via OpenAI ada-002), set up dual-query (Pinecone + Qdrant) with result parity verification, backfill any new vectors added during migration, cutover application queries from Pinecone to Qdrant, and verify search quality (recall@k ≥ 0.98). Risk factors: index rebuild taking > 48 hours, parity skew from different distance metrics, Qdrant cluster not handling production query load, cutover gap missing vectors. Tools available: Qdrant, OpenAI API, Python, kubectl, Helm.
